samples.summary: Slides toolbar change documented only in the docs-area design doc; the canonical slides toolbar doc is now stale
samples.evidence: `slides-toolbar-redesign.md:254` enumerates the State-3 text-edit toolbar as "B / I / U, Color, Link | Shared `text-format-group.tsx`, rendered with `showStrikethrough={false}` and `showHighlight={false}`" and line 260 repeats the same flag list for the mobile `TextFormatSheet`. This change adds a third opt-in flag (`showRemoveLink`) to both surfaces (`text-edit-section.tsx:93`, `mobile-toolbar.tsx:580`) and a visible new button, but records the decision in `docs/design/docs/docs-font-controls.md` under a new "### Removing a link on slides" heading instead of folding it into the slides toolbar doc, which now under-describes the shipped surface. Repo discipline is to fold into the canonical subsystem doc rather than describe a subsystem from a neighbouring one.

samples.summary: New Slides Remove-link toolbar button is scope beyond the issue's plan and acceptance criteria
samples.evidence: The originating task (`docs/tasks/active/20260908-docs-clear-formatting-keeps-links-todo.md`) scopes five steps (constant, shortcut collapse, contract comments, design-doc note, tests) and five acceptance criteria, none of which mention a new toolbar control. This change additionally adds a `showRemoveLink` prop plus an unlink `ToolbarButton` to the shared `TextFormatGroup` and opts both slides text-edit surfaces in. The rationale (slides has no link popover, so removal would otherwise be unreachable) is plausible and is documented, but it is unrequested UI scope landing in a shared cross-surface component inside a model/behaviour fix, in a package (`packages/frontend`) with no `tsc` lane.

samples.summary: The collapsed-caret "re-arm the link exit" rule is hand-copied into two editors rather than shared, the exact drift pattern this change set out to remove
samples.evidence: `editor.ts:3362-3372` and `text-editor.ts:3437-3450` contain the same predicate (`isAtLinkTrailingEdge(...) || (prev && 'href' in prev && prev.href === undefined)`) and the same `{ ...CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE, href: undefined }` payload, written out twice. The change correctly extracted the *predicate* (`isAtLinkTrailingEdge` into `model/caret-style.ts`), and the lessons file itself notes "sharing the list is not sharing the rule" — yet the rule that combines predicate + payload is duplicated, so a future change to what Clear formatting stages at a caret must be made in two places or the toolbar and Cmd+\ will diverge again (the original #1051 failure mode).
